detector.batch: median of 10 traces without crossing session boundaries
detector.constant_replacement_limit: add and immediate-move paths retire the same number of instructions and can have the same uop count; standard counters do not provide a stable semantic opcode-class signal
detector.feature_selection: none; channels and directions are predeclared

structural.score: absolute retired-instruction deviation from session-local benign reference

uop_substitution.gate: retired instruction count must equal session reference
uop_substitution.intended_target: random replacement implemented as a potentially move-eliminated register move
uop_substitution.score: maximum one-sided uop-issued or uop-executed deficit

hybrid_integrity_channel.score: used masked intermediate differs from redundantly computed normal intermediate
hybrid_integrity_channel.window_effect: comparison occurs after the PMU window and does not alter the target operation

detector.name: roulette-semantics-derived-two-tier-v1
detector.normalization: session-local benign reference median and robust scale
